# research nix

Look at [Nix](https://nixos.org/) — and [Nixery](https://nixery.dev/), which serves ad-hoc container images built from Nix packages — as a possible replacement for the Homebrew-plus-scripts approach to a reproducible workstation: declarative package sets, rollbacks, the same definition on macOS and Linux.
